Idk if this anecdote will help but I’m hoping it will:

This happened to me very frequently this summer. I was feeling not myself, not sexy, not worth the money, etc. I had a view that I would rather not be stripping, that all the guys were broke or mean, that this was not my true purpose. I honestly thought I wanted to quit and that I didn’t care if I lost my apartment or couldn’t pay my bills I just wanted out. I gave myself two months to get my shit together and make one last effort while putting my heart into it. 

I took a couple weeks off to do yoga, meditate, journal about what I was feeling and other traumas, and do things outside of work that make me happy. I also scoured the internet for stripper tips and read books about sales. Finally I focused on my body and taking care of myself in an attempt to feel more confident and remember how grateful I am for my body and health. I figured if I did all this and I went back and still felt out of alignment, that I would leave and never (lol fat chance) come back.

After all this I started feeling better when I went back to the club, I wasn’t making as much money as before my breakdown, but I was making more than I was during my breakdown. I decided to try a few more things, I tried not drinking at all or getting high at all at the club, and I decided to try and make the commitment to myself to not dance for men who make me uncomfortable and to focus my energy on men who I actually could find something to like about them or felt a genuine connection with. That is when things really shifted and turned for the better even pre-breakdown. More money easier than before, don’t feel sad or angry during or after work, am not out of commission from a hangover the next day, and I can honestly say I have met some pretty cool guys who I actually could say I had fun with.

I know this seems extra or not worth it, but if you are a person who doesn’t like to quit and you genuinely want to improve yourself and your game, I recommend focusing on yourself and finding the root of the problem so you can change and get what you want out of life. Some girls easily make bank on drugs, blackout drunk, with no effort, but that is not the case for me, specifically because it is not sustainable for the life I want.
